item.title: Bombs Over Homes: Afghan Civilians Paying the Price for Pakistan’s Airstrikes - The Afghan Times
item.description: When bombs fall on homes instead of battlefields, the victims are not Taliban. They are families. Mothers. Children. The latest Pakistani airstrikes on Afghanistan’s major cities, including Kabul and Kandahar, have once again highlighted a painful reality: in this escalating conflict, Afghan civilians are paying the highest price. item.title: First Update: Pakistani Airstrike on Kabul Drug Treatment Center Kills at Least 250, Toll Likely Higher - The Afghan Times
item.description: Rescue operations are ongoing at a 2,000-bed drug treatment center in Kabul after it was hit by a Pakistani military airstrike Monday evening, local media report. Preliminary reports indicate that at least 250 civilians have been killed, with the toll likely to rise, and over 400 others injured. Emergency teams are still recovering victims from the debris.
